title: OpenTelemetry trace projection with borrowed GenAI conventions, no dependency, no content
summary: orchestrate trace <run-id> projects a run's append-only telemetry into OTLP/JSON: invoke_workflow (root, marked provisional), node, invoke_agent (gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.provider.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.response.model from the resolved model, gen_ai.usage.* tokens, error.type) and execute_tool validator spans; other events become span events. Only allowlisted structural fields are exported (tests plant secret markers in the goal and worker output and assert they never appear). Validation: strict parse into the official opentelemetry-proto ExportTraceServiceRequest (dev venv only) succeeded for a two-task run (11 spans). Any OTLP/HTTP receiver that accepts JSON (for example the OpenTelemetry Collector's otlphttp receiver at /v1/traces) can ingest the file; Phoenix (PA-phoenix) stays deferred.

prior_art.found: GenAI semantic conventions for model/tool/agent spans; exporters are dependency-heavy
prior_art.reused: attribute names and span taxonomy from the GenAI conventions; official opentelemetry-proto used only as an external validator
prior_art.why_custom: a ~200-line stdlib projection avoids the OTel SDK dependency and keeps the privacy allowlist in Agent OS
